data.professional_title: AI & Data Solutions Architect | GenAI Engineer | ML Engineer
data.summary:
AI, ML, GenAI and data science professional with 9+ years of hands-on experience delivering enterprise analytics, PyTorch deep learning models, RAG applications, LangGraph agentic frameworks, and Power BI/Sisense BI solutions. Expert in architecting GenAI-powered SQL assistants, multi-agent workflows, Azure/AWS cloud data systems, and KPI-heavy dashboards used by leadership teams.
Proven track record leading 5-11 member teams, owning end-to-end delivery cycles, stakeholder alignment, Agile execution, performance optimization, and transforming business requirements into scalable AI/ML-driven solutions.
AI / ML / GENAI SKILLS
Deep Learning: PyTorch, CNNs, RNNs, neural network classifiers, embeddings
Generative AI: LangGraph multi-agent systems, Google AI SDK, Microsoft 365 AI Agents SDK, Langchain, Open AI, AWS Bedrock, Azure AI Foundry
RAG Pipelines: ChromaDB, FAISS, Pinecone vector search, retrieval augmented generation
Large Language Models: Azure OpenAI (GPT-4o, GPT-4 Turbo, GPT-5), Groq API, Gemini
Agentic AI: SQL agents, tool-calling agents, retrieval agents, workflow orchestration
Predictive Modeling: Time series forecasting, classification, churn prediction, regression analysis
Model Evaluation: Exact Match/F1 scores, hallucination reduction, grounding tests

raw_sections.experience:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
R SYSTEMS INTERNATIONAL Project Leader - AI, Data Engineering & BI Noida, India Oct 2021 - Present
Key Achievements:
Architected GenAI SQL Agent using LangGraph and Azure OpenAI, enabling natural language to SQL generation for non-technical users
Delivered a Relocation Analytics Chatbot (BenchmarkChat) for global mobility, enabling narrative Q&A using policy documents, survey data, and destination-based knowledge via RAG
Designed a Customer Support Q&A Agent trained on internal SOPs, escalation rules, and domain knowledge, reducing manual dependency for operations teams.
Built multiple agentic AI workflows as POC (BI Assistant, Legal Draft Agent, BenchmarkChat, etc.) using LangGraph, DSPy, and Chroma, integrating retrieval, tools, and context-engineering
Built an Industrial Product Sales Agent that matches client requirements with SKUs, BOQ specs, furniture types, and export-ready catalogues.
Led cross-functional teams of 5-11 members across AI/ML and BI functions
Owned stakeholder alignment, Agile sprint planning, backlog management, and product-centric delivery
Major Projects:
1. Aires - AI & ML Intelligence Solution Designed and delivered AI-driven and agentic intelligence solution for global relocation company, integrating machine learning predictions, LLM-based reasoning, and automated data workflows.
Key Contributions:
Developed ML models for forecasting business volumes and policy spends using PyTorch and scikit-learn
Built Agentic AI system using LangGraph enabling natural language policy queries, automated analysis and insight generation
Implemented RAG workflows for retrieving relocation, HR, immigration, assignment, and destination city policies
Integrated model outputs into Sisense using custom Python scripts, providing dynamic KPIs, alerts, and narrative insights
Automated data processing pipelines using Python, SQL, and Azure Databricks components
Improved decision-making for relocations, exceptions, housing allowances, move volumes, and program-level performance
2. TaskUs - Billing Dashboard (scikit-learn, ML & Power BI)
Conducted business discovery sessions and gathered KPI and reporting requirements from stakeholders
Designed semantic data model with fact tables, dimension tables, and incremental loads
Developed scikit-learn pipelines (IsolationForest, Logistic Regression) to detect anomalous billing patterns and high-risk entries
Exposed model outputs (risk flags, anomaly scores, predicted utilization) as SQL tables consumed by Power BI
Integrated ML-generated risk scores and forecast outputs into Power BI, enabling predictive KPIs and proactive dashboard alerts
3. TaskUs - AutoEncoder for Anomaly Detection
Designed PyTorch AutoEncoder to detect anomalous operational patterns in log data, billing entries, and utilization metrics
Model identified spikes, duplicate activities, and abnormal usage trends, automatically flagging high-risk cases for QA teams
Integrated anomaly scores into Power BI dashboards for management visibility and real-time monitoring
FINANALYTIC CAPITAL PVT. LTD. Assistant Data Lead Mumbai, India Aug 2018 - Oct 2021
Key Achievements:
Led 10-member Data Science team delivering analytics solutions, ML models, and ETL pipelines
Built end-to-end Azure Data Factory and Azure Databricks workflows for financial performance analytics and automated reporting
Implemented ML models (scikit-learn: RandomForest, Logistic Regression, IsolationForest) to detect financial anomalies, predict revenue trends, and identify outlier transactions
Reduced manual reporting work by 120+ hours per month through automation and cloud-scale transformation pipelines
Designed interactive Power BI dashboards with predictive KPIs and early-warning indicators for leadership
Key Responsibilities:
Collaborated with business and finance stakeholders to define KPIs, capture analytical requirements, and translate them into measurable data products and ML use cases.
Applied ML techniques—Random Forests, Logistic Regression, Gradient Boosting, and K-Means clustering—to enhance forecasting accuracy and detect anomalies across spending, revenue, cash flow, and investment KPIs.
Implemented predictive models for churn, sales forecasting, budget variance prediction, and cost trend analysis using structured, time-series, and semi-structured datasets.
Developed transformation notebooks in Azure Databricks (PySpark) to cleanse, aggregate, and enrich financial datasets for reporting and ML models
Applied ML techniques (RandomForest, Logistic Regression, K-Means clustering) to improve forecasting accuracy and detect anomalies in spending, revenue, and investment metrics
Led Agile ceremonies including backlog refinement, sprint planning, and stakeholder demos, ensuring smooth delivery cycles
Published curated datasets and ML outputs to SQL/ADF pipelines for consumption in Power BI dashboards
FINANALYTIC CAPITAL Senior Software Engineer - Analytics Delhi, India 
May 2016 - Jul 2018
Performed data review, validation, and preprocessing (cleaning, encoding, imputations, outlier checks) to prepare high-quality datasets for traditional machine learning workflows.
Managed ETL/ELT pipelines and ensured accurate deployment of structured data into enterprise data warehouses for downstream ML model consumption.
Produced weekly and monthly analytical reports highlighting model performance metrics, data drift indicators, and business KPIs derived from ML outputs.
Conducted data profiling and exploratory analysis to detect anomalies, distribution shifts, multicollinearity, and feature importance patterns.
Collected and integrated data from multiple sources (databases, APIs, flat files) to build comprehensive, feature-rich datasets for model training and evaluation.
Designed and developed Power BI dashboards to visualize feature-level insights, prediction outputs, and real-world ML performance metrics for stakeholders.
GENPACT Process Developer - ETL & Analytics Noida, India 
Feb 2015 - Apr 2016
Design, Build and deploy effective Predictive Model on structured data
Visualize Model Predictions.
Identify and test for bugs and bottlenecks.
Collaborate with other teams within the organization and be able to devise the technical solution as it relates to the business & technical requirements
